library(metacor)

metacor: Meta-analysis with Correlated Data

metacor is an R package designed to facilitate the calculation of effect sizes and imputation of missing values in studies with pre-post and intervention-control designs. It offers robust handling of missing correlations, standard deviations, and generates a detailed report for reproducibility.
